title: Super Bowl LX MVP Kenneth Walker III saves best performance for dad's first NFL game

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Super Bowl LX MVP Kenneth Walker III saves best performance for dad's first NFL game
sources.description: Seattle Seahawks running back and Super Bowl LX MVP Kenneth Walker III had a breakout season in 2025 and saved his best performance for last, which happened to be his dad’s first NFL game.
